text.p: ValuJet Inc confirmed Monday it will resume service on December 19 between Atlanta and Dallas/Fort Worth, West Palm Beach and Fort Myers at introductory rates as low as $49 one-way.
The low-cost carrier also said it will add 10 additional daily, nonstop flights between Atlanta and Orlando, Fort Lauderdale and Tampa as well as Chicago and Washington, D.C.
With this additional service, ValuJet will operate 128 peak daily system departures to 20 cities.

ValuJet has slowly rebuilt service since it resumed service September 30. But the airline has only a fraction of service compared to the 320 daily flights to 31 cities it offered before its grounding.
The carrier was grounded in June, due to the aftermath of the Flight 592 crash in the Florida Everglades that killed 110 passengers and crew on board.
